experimental_context.taxon_grounding_basis: Source species name matched to the cached UniProt taxonomy lineage.

taxonomy.taxonomy_provenance_note: Historical retrieval has cohort plan and receipt, not a separate attempt file.

interpretation.ERG24: Library association does not establish single-locus causality; reconstructed clones were nonviable.
interpretation.ERG28: Figure reports library Nig resistance but reconstructed BY Val resistance; retain the discrepancy.
interpretation.ERG5: Reconstruction not validated; not included in the independent-clone analysis.
interpretation.compound_identity: S1 Table names reagents but does not establish exact form/catalog identity.
interpretation.hidden_sheets: Two ancillary comparison sheets retained privately; not extra independent subjects.
interpretation.measurement: Qualitative laboratory growth categories; no MIC conversion or clinical breakpoint inference.
interpretation.null_drug_label: Not classified for that drug in the source cell; not inferred susceptibility.
interpretation.reference_hold: HTTP 400 query-size rejection, not absence of matching proteins; no retry or alternate route.
interpretation.respiration_deficiency: ERG2/ERG3 in SCY325 are not interpretable as drug hypersensitivity.
interpretation.screen_limits: About half the final phenotypes varied across experiments; secondary changes can confound single-gene attribution.
interpretation.source_annotation: Protein/function descriptions and GO annotations are not direct-target proof.
interpretation.unstarred_row: No stable marker; not automatically a proven unstable phenotype.
